hook_specs.trigger: trainer line-of-sight hits the player (any NPC trainer; company/RT trainers use spark_rt)

sequence.step: freeze player input; player finishes current 16 px step, then stands
eye_glint: 2 frames x 50 ms on the trainer (eye_points.json; facing left/right = one eye)
hop: trainer sprite y offset HOP_DY px per frame, spark rides along (spark frame 01 held)
spark frames 02 (120 ms), 03 (80 ms) then remove
trainer walks toward the player at normal walk speed (16 px / 62 ms per frame) until adjacent, then dialogue

hook_specs.spark_anchor: spark bottom-centre (12,23) at (sprite_x + 32, sprite_y + head_top - 2); head_top per NPC in eye_points.json
hook_specs.emotes: spotted/emotes/emote_<name>: play 00 once (60 ms) then loop 01/02 (260 ms each); bottom-centre (12,23) at head_top - 1
hook_specs.reduced_motion: skip hop (keep spark frame 01 for 360 ms)
hook_specs.sfx_note: not art: a short rising chime on spark frame 01

hit_sequence_order: impact frame of the attack effect lands

hit_stop.what: freeze ALL battle animation (effects, idles, bobbing). Audio keeps playing; the hit SFX starts at freeze start.
hit_stop.note: critical = 90 ms (our choice; playbook only defines 60 ms)

hit_flash.how: draw the target as a solid fcf6e8 silhouette (provided per creature: creatures/<c>/<c>_<view>_flash) on the white frames. First white frame starts with hit_stop.
hit_flash.reduced_motion: one frame of 50% Bayer white (bayer_fade of the silhouette at t=0.5) for 33 ms

shake.applies_to: world layer (background, platforms, both creatures); HUD/HP boxes stay still for readability

strong_hit.when: the move is strong against the target (type advantage)

shake.decay: roughly linear: amplitude x (1 - step/steps), sign alternates; table above is authoritative (pixel-integer, native 320x240)

hp_drain.tick_sfx: every 3 bar px (bar is 102 px wide)

drop.clip: rows below the original foot line are hidden (sinks into the platform)

faint.sfx: cry pitched down at flicker start, thud at drop end
faint.reduced_motion: play flicker, skip drop; fade frames still play

overuse.trigger: energy overuse event (any time the crystal is pushed past its limit)

trigger.condition: player idle (no input) 30 000 ms on (1,8) facing up, after a heal this visit; Trail Buddy out (not in ball); once per in-game day gives +2 Warmth (flag), the scene itself can replay
trigger.cancel: any input during the 30 s resets the timer

sequence: 1. player: <name>_sofa_sit_down (7 fr, 64x160 canvas, anchor (32,157) on the (1,8) foot point). Lock input.

2. buddy walks to (1,8) (normal follow step, facing up), then hops into the lap: use its up walk1 frame, tween its foot from (96, 8*64+61) to the lap point over 6 frames; add the HOP lift (px up) per frame; land with a 1-frame vscale(3) squash (= settle frame 0).
3. buddy: <c>_lap_settle (7 fr) then <c>_lap_sleep loop; after the first sleep frame show emote_zzz (spotted/emotes) loop at zzz_anchor, 600 ms per frame.
4. player: <name>_sofa_seated loop (draw the buddy AFTER the player).
5. after 2 s of sleep: healer line (text) "Don't move. Those are the rules." - healer at (6,3) faces left toward the sofa while it shows.
6. any input: buddy <c>_lap_wake, hop down (HOP reversed) to (1,8)->(1,9) follow slot, then <name>_sofa_stand_up; unlock.

hook_specs.reduced_motion: skip the hop tween (cut straight to settle frame 6) and the breathing loops (hold frame 0)
